title: Pre-registered strategy registry — singles, parlays, player-prop combos
pre_registration_note: This file is committed BEFORE engine/backtest.py is first run. Strategies, thresholds, baselines and prices are fixed here; the backtest may not change them. Any later change must be appended as an amendment with its own timestamp and reason.

price_assumption.label: ASSUMED -110
price_assumption.note: The NFL publishes no betting prices (see flags). Every staking figure assumes a flat -110 price (risk 1.10 to win 1.00) on singles and the product price (10/11)^k for k-leg parlays. This is an ASSUMPTION, not a market observation, and is flagged as such everywhere it appears. Signal metrics never use prices.

strategies.name: Model side (every game)
strategies.rule: For each settled walk-forward game, pick the side with the higher model win probability (home if p_home >= 0.5, else away). Flat 1 unit at the ASSUMED -110 price.
strategies.signal_metric: pick accuracy vs 0.500 baseline and vs always-home baseline
strategies.baseline: 0.500 accuracy (coin flip) and home-win base rate

strategies.name: Total over own fair total
strategies.rule: Bet Over the model's own fair total for each settled walk-forward game at the ASSUMED -110 price, flat 1u. Wins when the actual combined score exceeds the fair total.
strategies.signal_metric: over-hit rate vs 0.500 (calibration) + total MAE vs baseline
strategies.baseline: 0.500 over-hit rate; league-mean total MAE baseline

strategies.name: Model underdog moneyline
strategies.rule: For each settled walk-forward game, pick the side the model rates as LESS likely to win (the model underdog). Flat 1 unit at the ASSUMED -110 price.
strategies.signal_metric: upset-hit rate vs the base rate of the model-underdog winning
strategies.baseline: model-underdog base win rate computed on the same sample (reported, not assumed)

strategies.name: Two-leg cross-game parlay
strategies.rule: Each week take the two highest model-confidence S1 picks from DIFFERENT games (confidence = |p - 0.5|). One parlay per week at the ASSUMED product price (10/11)^2. Same-game legs are forbidden (gate G6).
strategies.signal_metric: both-legs-win rate vs product of individual rates
strategies.baseline: independence product of the two legs' empirical win rates

strategies.name: Player prop combo (QB passing + WR receiving)
strategies.rule: Two-leg player-prop combo. BLOCKED: no official player-prop prices or official prop lines exist in any source read by this project.
strategies.blocked_reason: No official prop prices (flag FB-05). Cannot be validated, cannot be staked, cannot score.

reward_policy.rule: Signal decides eligibility; staking confirms it. A strategy must pass signal gate G2 AND staking gate G5 to earn points. A lucky staking run on a strategy that fails G2 cannot score any points, and cannot outrank a G2-passing strategy. Points awarded = 0 until at least one strategy passes both.
reward_policy.status: policy only — no funds are held; rewards are research points, not money.

amendments.change: Eligibility additionally requires gate G7 (price basis verified against an official price source). Until an official price source exists, points stay at 0 even when G2/G4/G5 pass on the ASSUMED -110 price.
amendments.reason: The assumed -110 on straight-up side picks is not an obtainable market price (favorites are priced with much heavier juice). Paying points on a return computed from an unobtainable price would misrepresent the result. This amendment was made after the first backtest run and is disclosed here verbatim rather than silently applied to the pre-registered rule.

amendments.change: A POST-HOC diagnostic baseline (pick the team with the better record entering each game) is reported alongside the pre-registered baselines. It does not replace the pre-registered G2 baseline and does not change any gate outcome.
amendments.reason: Transparency: the post-hoc baseline is the fair naive comparison a reviewer would ask for, and it must be shown even when it is unfavourable to the model.
amendments.effect: reported in backtest metrics and on the leaderboard page
